##: 萌宠出征 - Desktop pet survivor / bullet-heaven game for Windows. Maintained in tiyinet/scoop-bucket.
description: MengChongcz - a cozy desktop pet survivor game for Windows. Raise one pet, fight through 40 stages across 4 worlds, unlock a desktop-pet mode after stage 5. 16 breeds of cats, dogs, birds and turtles. Fully offline, no ads, no gacha, no in-app purchase.
notes: Desktop pet survivor game: 40 stages, 4 worlds, 16 pet breeds, endless mode.
